pages.en: Grandpa wants to read his book, but he can't find his glasses. "Where are my glasses?" he asks.
pages.zh: 爷爷想看书，可是找不到他的眼镜了。“我的眼镜在哪儿？”他问。
pages.scene: Grandpa in his armchair holding a book far away at arm's length, squinting hard at it with bare eyes, a puzzled look, a question mark above his head.

pages.en: Lily and Tom look everywhere. They look in his coat pocket, in his hat and under the chair. No glasses!
pages.zh: Lily 和 Tom 到处找。他们找了爷爷的外套口袋、帽子和椅子底下。没有眼镜！
pages.scene: Lily looking in a coat pocket on a hook, Tom looking under an armchair, Grandpa's hat upside down on the table.

pages.en: Then Lily looks in Max's bed. Grandpa's glasses are there! "Max!" everyone laughs. Grandpa says, "Thank you, Lily. Now I can read!"
pages.zh: 这时 Lily 往 Max 的狗窝里一看，爷爷的眼镜就在那儿！“Max！”大家都笑了。爷爷说：“谢谢你，Lily。现在我能看书了！”
pages.scene: A round dog bed with a pair of round glasses lying on its cushion, Max sitting next to it with a guilty look, Lily pointing at the glasses and laughing, Grandpa and Tom laughing behind her.
